title: docs(qa): re-point list type-size and drill-container checklist clauses to later rulings
body:
Fixes #37035
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改平台测试清单里三条验收条款和一个界面测试文件的说明注释，产品本身不变。
- 为什么做：两次里程碑验收发现清单还按旧规定判（列表字号统一 13、看明细从右侧抽屉打开），而产品已按后来的裁决改成两档字号和居中弹窗，下一轮验收会误报失败。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这三条验收的写法仍有偏差，下次照清单验收时多一条误报；不影响任何用户数据，回退本合并即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **`records-forms.list-view-capabilities` (revision 15 → 16).** `steps[6]` and `acceptance[10]` now read the two-tier type scale of #36047 (closed 2026-11-21 on the maintainer's 「同意」: body 14, labels and section headings 12): 12px on the header labels, 14px on the cells and the bar buttons, where they read 13px on all three. Set by merged code: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:749` (header `text-xs`) and `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/listToolbarRow.ts:74` (bar trigger `text-sm`); milestone acceptance #37020 read 12 and 14 live on main 305fe60e. `acceptance[10]`'s `verify` now says the e2e pin compiles the real classes onto a transcribed element tree, not the live page.
- **`dashboards.drill-through-range` (revision 2 → 3).** `steps[6]`, `acceptance[4]` and the `chart.zod.ts` source line now read the centred, non-modal drill dialog over the standard list with labelled chips (#36256, #36461), not the side drawer. Merged code: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx:645` and `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:1574` pass `target="dialog"`; `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DrillDownDrawer.tsx:283-296` draws it (`w-[70vw] h-[65vh]`, `modal={false}`, `data-testid` drill-down-dialog).
- **`dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` (revision 1 → 2).** The title, `steps[2]`/`[3]`, `acceptance[1]`/`[2]` and `negative[0]` say the drill dialog where they said the drawer. What the dialog must list (the bucket AND the measure scope) is unchanged.
- **`ui/e2e/list-frame-geometry-35548.spec.ts` (doc comment only).** States that the file never opens the live app (it compiles the real classes onto a transcribed tree, and the live reading is driven by hand), marks the old 32 / 33 / 13px live reading as before #36048 and #36047, and drops the stale "no page bar" sentence (the file already measures #36113's 44px page bar). No assertion changed.

## Tests

No product code and no test assertion changed; no live run was made. Each re-point is to merged code on main 254e396a, cited above by file and line.

<details><summary>Derived gates (head 3a16678c4)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 27 commands for the three paths; all 27 ran locally and exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built); after `turbo run build` of those two under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0) it exited 0.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 0; `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exit 0; `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `27 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 27 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 27 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Premise partly superseded: the card's third bullet (32/33 px heights "in its e2e description") no longer holds on the item. At 254e396a the item reads 32 / 33 only inside revision 15's history row; the remaining 32 / 33 / 13px text was the e2e spec's "live reading" comment, which now dates it.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts:541-542` still declares `'drawer'` as the drill `target` default, while the report and dataset-widget hosts hard-code the dialog; reported to the seat, not edited here (spec is outside this card's surface).

## Verification

Read first: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/dashboards.json` (drill-through-range `acceptance[4]`), `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` (list-view-capabilities `acceptance[10]`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 0 and accepts the three revision bumps with their history rows.
